prerequisite_d2_gate.rule: Stage D3 LLM Analyst calls (B/C) are strictly blocked unless Stage D2 V3-P3 ceiling >= threshold.

analyst_groups.M: Zero-cost majority-class / best-fixed-arm baseline (0 LLM requests)
analyst_groups.A: Deterministic rule / keyword heuristic baseline on L2 facts.jsonl (0 LLM requests; R17)
analyst_groups.B: Real LLM (gemini-3.8-flash) reading raw L1 trajectory log up to anchor k (1 LLM request / unit)
analyst_groups.C: Real LLM (gemini-3.8-flash) reading L1 trajectory + L2 zero-request facts.jsonl up to anchor k (1 LLM request / unit)

stop_conditions: Do not execute unless D2 V3-P3 gate is open (`d3_prerequisite_gate_open == True`).
Abort if any B/C prompt fails zero-score-leakage check (no s(k) or grades.jsonl allowed).
Abort if HTTP error or invalid JSON schema rate exceeds 5%.
